dedupe_keys.name: multi sensor vehicle trajectories dataset for localization and perception

description: Multi-Sensor Vehicle Trajectories Dataset for Localization and Perception is a data set deposited in rdg.prod by its authors Gérald Dherbomez ((Univ. Lille, CNRS, Centrale Lille, UMR 9189 CRIStAL, F-59000 Lille, France)). This dataset contains complete recordings of trajectories performed by an experimental vehicle equipped with a wide range of perception and positioning sensors. The data is intended for research and development in the fields of localization, mapping, sensor fusion, robotic perception, and autonomous navigation, with 7 different trajectories. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
